description: This file defines the API, data structures, macros, and constants for the keyboard matrix input driver in Zephyr OS. It includes function prototypes, configuration macros, and type definitions related to managing keyboard matrix hardware.

methods.name: input_kbd_matrix_actual_key_mask_set
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific row, column combination in the key mask at runtime, if dynamic key mask configuration is enabled.

methods.name: input_kbd_matrix_poll_start
methods.description: Starts the scanning cycle of the keyboard matrix, typically called after a key press event.

methods.name: input_kbd_matrix_common_init
methods.description: Initializes the keyboard matrix device at startup, to be called at the end of device initialization.
